name: inferindex
description: Compare LLM API prices across 70+ providers and aggregators: cheapest offer for a model, provider comparison with usage conditions, price history and cost estimates.

interface.shortDescription: Live LLM API prices and cost estimates
interface.longDescription: Find the cheapest provider for an LLM model, compare every provider with its usage conditions and reliability, estimate what a workload will cost per request and per month, and check how a price moved. Answers come from live InferIndex data, with the API call behind each number.
defaultPrompt: Which provider is cheapest for DeepSeek V3.2 right now?
